QUOTE: "**Option A: compile time.** Set `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO=my_calloc` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO=my_free`" / "**Option B: runtime.** Set `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and leave both macros undefined." / "No runtime hook exists in this mode."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter. It says the runtime option requires leaving the macros undefined and that no runtime hook exists in macro mode, so the two are mutually exclusive.
